title: Smoked Salmon Sandwich
description: A delicious and easy-to-make gluten-free sandwich, perfect for a light lunch or snack.

ingredients.name: Tea leaves
ingredients.notes: dried and used as a garnish

instructions: Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
Lay a slice of toasted Scottish flatbread on a clean surface.
Spread a layer of silky cream cheese on the flatbread, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Place 2 oz of smoked salmon on top of the cream cheese.
Add 2 slices of afternoon tea pickles on top of the salmon.
Drizzle a tablespoon of mustardy mayonnaise over the pickles.
Top with another slice of toasted Scottish flatbread.
Place the sandwich in the panini press or grill and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown.
Garnish with a sprinkle of tea leaves and serve immediately.
